workstreamName: Multi-view Visual Buyer Analysis, Overview summary, and PI placement
operatorOutcome: Deal 81 shows one structured multi-view Visual Buyer Analysis (sections A-E) grounded in the combined accepted visual evidence in Property Intelligence, and a concise grounded Visual Buyer Summary on Overview with a control opening the full analysis; no fabricated facts, no legal conclusions, no superseded interpretation left visible.

requirements.text: One structured Visual Buyer Analysis with sections A-E, grounded in the combined multi-view evidence, is visible in V2 Property Intelligence.
A concise grounded Visual Buyer Summary appears on V2 Overview with a control opening the full analysis.
Conflicting visual evidence is reconciled; stronger evidence supersedes and no superseded interpretation remains visible.
No fabricated facts, legal conclusions, or guaranteed buildability/legal-access/septic/boundary/wetlands claims appear.
Existing page structure and visual system are preserved; compact comparable summary retained; no full comparable cards duplicated in PI.

steps: Open V2 Overview for deal 81 and confirm the concise Visual Buyer Summary appears with physical character, main appeal, and top concern
Use its control to open/expand the full Visual Buyer Analysis in Property Intelligence
Confirm sections A-E are all present and grounded in the multi-view evidence
Confirm the corridor description matches the reconciled conclusion and no superseded interpretation remains
Confirm no fabricated facts, legal conclusions, or guaranteed buildability/access/septic/boundary/wetlands claims
Refresh both sections and confirm the analysis and summary persist

requiredVisibleOutcomes: Must NOT occur: Analysis based on one aerial image alone or containing fabricated/legal/guaranteed claims
Must NOT occur: Overview summary missing, unscannable, or lacking the expand control
Must NOT occur: A superseded interpretation remains visible after stronger evidence
Must NOT occur: Any section A-E missing from the full analysis
Must NOT occur: Full comparable cards duplicated inside PI or the page redesigned
mandate: Actively attempt to prove the implementation wrong; never repeat the builder's conclusions.
Open the actual running localhost dashboard in a real browser.
Navigate the full affected workflow; click every relevant control and open every affected tab.
Exercise relevant forms, maps, filters, tables, links, and actions.
Compare visible frontend output with API responses and, when appropriate, database records.
Compare visible output with accepted operator facts.
Refresh the browser and verify persistence; when restart persistence is required, restart via npm run landos:restart and reopen the workflow.
Capture fresh screenshots and exact reproduction steps for every failure.
Judge business meaning and operator usability, not merely whether pages load.
Return a non-passing result whenever an internally fixable issue remains.
After repairs, run the exact same journey again.
